name: seo-content-brief
summary: Create an evidence-backed SEO brief for a new page or existing-page refresh and hand it to the Writing discipline.
writes: Home.md review link when review is required
external_reads: live page and linked assets when approved
approval_gates: onboarding: collect substantial client context before producing a durable brief; use significant /grill-me intake when required context is absent
external_read: ask before reading live pages, source URLs, current search results, or competitor pages
provider_data: use only providers the User has identified as installed/configured; paid or credentialed calls require the applicable approval
competitor_analysis: ask before running competitor-page analysis
vault_write: save only to a resolved project, client, or prospect context when authorized
external_mutation: publishing, CMS, repository, production, and provider configuration changes are out of scope
done_when: mode is new-page or refresh and page type is explicit
client, project, or prospect context and substantial onboarding context are resolved
business goal, audience, market/language, funnel stage, and desired action are explicit
opportunity inputs and approved search-data sources are recorded with dates and scope
search intent is distinct from business objective and funnel stage
refresh mode includes existing-page inspection scope
brief translates SEO evidence into Writing requirements without final prose or metadata
durable artifacts use the project/client/prospect routing and review frontmatter contract
seo-quality-gate passes or is explicitly deferred with an actionable reason
verification: verify source labels distinguish first-party data, provider estimates, manual observations, studies, heuristics, hypotheses, and assumptions
verify undeclared providers were not probed
verify competitor analysis was approved before external reading
verify claim-check handling when material claims are present
verify no final title tag, meta description, article prose, web copy, publishing, or production mutation was produced
verify changed Markdown/frontmatter and Home review registration when applicable
